## ILibFileProvider interface

Interface for providing TypeScript lib file content.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface ILibFileProvider 
```

## Remarks

This interface allows the virtual compiler host to resolve lib files (like lib.es2020.d.ts) without requiring them to be in the virtual filesystem.
